# Minimum mutation score, as a whole-number percentage of caught / (caught + missed).
# Enforced against this one number by both Mutants (weekly) — the whole crate on
# `main`, the real signal — and Mutants (PR diff), when the diff has enough mutants
# to mean anything.
#
# Raise it once the weekly run has cleared the new value twice. Never lower it to
# turn a build green: the drop is the signal, not the problem.
#
# Seeded low. Measured locally at 63% (822/1285 scored) over 1407 of 2192 mutants;
# the unmeasured remainder is mostly src/cli/subcmd/*, which scored worse, so the
# true figure is likely a few points under. The first full weekly run replaces this
# estimate with a measurement.
50
